pairs.subject: agent-cli-transport
pairs.evidence: src/app/api/feature-matrix/batch-review/route.ts:56 The batch feature review is an assessment task (cli-task.ts itself calls reviews 'read-only'), but the route spawns the agent CLI in the UE project's working directory through the generic startExecution door. It declares no readonly-scan mode, so the run inherits the transport's one stance (`--dangerously-skip-permissions`, cli-service.ts:247) and could write to the workspace it is only meant to assess.

techniques.evidence: src/app/api/feature-matrix/batch-review/route.ts:56 A read-only review is launched with no mode argument and no read-only factory, so nothing makes the scan unable to write. The shared spawn door adds --dangerously-skip-permissions to every run.

src/app/api/feature-matrix/batch-review/route.ts:81 A failed run is stored as a typed reason plus message from the settlement result, not as a bare exit code or an empty 'completed'. The envelope parsing itself happens in run-settle and cli-service, outside this context.
